verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a sandbox platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only a TypeScript SDK and Worker-based APIs (sandbox.exec, writeFile, sessions, tunnels) plus browser terminal UIs, and never mentions an official command-line tool. The SDK and in-sandbox shell execution are developer building blocks, not an official CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
